title: PCETbase: an open database of solution-phase PCET thermochemistry (BDFE, E°, pKa)
description: Open community database of solution-phase proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) thermochemistry: bond dissociation free energies (BDFE), standard potentials (E°) and pKa values on self-consistent scales, with per-entry provenance, reference-electrode conversions and a recomputable recommendation policy. Interactive explorer: https://carsten-streb.github.io/pcetbase/. Core data extracted from Agarwal et al., Chem. Rev. 2022, 122, 1-49 (doi:10.1021/acs.chemrev.1c00521), extended with primary-literature polyoxometalate entries, a complete transition-metal hydride campaign (Wiedner 2016 and Morris 2016 review tables plus primary literature, incl. aqueous M–H entries) and a complete metal-oxo/hydroxo (M–O–H) campaign from the primary literature (Fe, Mn, Cu, Ni, Zr/Co; water, MeCN, DMSO, THF), hydricities ΔG°(H⁻) with the BDFE↔hydricity closure, an experimental/computational origin label, a square-scheme view with named worked equations and units on every value, a curation statement and a per-entry verification ledger recording how every value was obtained and checked. v1.7 (submission release for the PCETbase paper) adds explicit raw-potential legs, reference offsets stated by the source, inequality bounds, σ types, source-caveat flags (estimated pKa, peak potentials), a conventions statement and frictionless/foreign-key validation, and corrects several v1.6 values and labels after an external expert review (see CHANGELOG,
). Please also cite the primary source of each value you use.
notes: Funding: This database is developed as part of the Collaborative Research Center SFB 1633 "PCET" (https://uni-goettingen.de/de/683468.html), funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft DFG (grant no: 536858973).
